描述_EN: this dish is an example of the yaozhou wares typical of the northern song dynasty (960-1127). while the wares produced at the yaozhou kiln complex enjoyed popularity from the end of the tang dynasty (618-906) through to the beginning of the yuan dynasty (1279-1368), these dishes exhibit the olive green glaze and dense surface designs common to the yaozhou wares of the northern song period. carving was an important method of surface decoration in yaozhou ware. angled tools were used to carve out the stylised waves and duck in sloping grooves, and comb-like tools provided the linear accents visible in the waves. the celadon glaze was then applied to the dish, pooling in the crevices and laying thinly on raised areas. through firing, the pooled areas grew darker in colour and the thinly glazed areas more transparent, creating the illusion of light and shadows in the surface design. the dish on the far left would have begun with a smooth clay body, partially dried (or ‘leather hard’).
描述_ZN: 此盘是北宋时期典型的耀州器皿的一个例子（960-1127）。 从唐朝末年（618-906）到元朝初年（1279-1368），耀州窑群生产的器物一直很受欢迎，这些盘子展示了北宋时期耀州器物常见的橄榄绿釉和密集的表面图案。 雕刻是耀州器物表面装饰的一种重要方法。 角形工具被用来在倾斜的凹槽中雕刻出风格化的波浪和鸭子，而梳状工具则提供了波浪中可见的线性点缀。 然后将青瓷釉涂在盘子上，在缝隙中积聚，在凸起的地方薄薄地铺上。 通过烧制，汇集的区域颜色越来越深，薄釉的区域越来越透明，在表面设计中创造出光和影的幻觉。 最左边的盘子开始时应该是光滑的泥体，部分干燥（或 "皮革硬"）。
